import { execSync } from "node:child_process"

examples.title: nest-cli.json tuzilmasi
generateOptions: spec
examples.code:
import { execSync } from "node:child_process"
import { mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs"
import { join } from "node:path"

const proj = mkdtempSync(join(process.cwd(), "proj-"))
mkdirSync(join(proj, "src"), { recursive: true })
writeFileSync(join(proj, "nest-cli.json"), JSON.stringify({
    collection: "@nestjs/schematics",
    sourceRoot: "src",
    generateOptions: { spec: false },
}))

console.log(execSync("npx nest g service users --dry-run", { cwd: proj, encoding: "utf-8" }).trim())
console.log("← .spec.ts fayli yaratilmadi, chunki generateOptions.spec = false")
rmSync(proj, { recursive: true, force: true })

    write("src/main.ts", `console.log("ok")\n`)

    execSync("npx nest build", { cwd: proj, stdio: "ignore" })
    console.log(`deleteOutDir=${deleteOutDir}: eski fayl qoldimi → ${existsSync(join(proj, "dist", "old-removed-file.js"))}`)
